# AbetConnect

> Customer conversations workspace: one ranked omnichannel inbox where churn
> risks and high-value enquiries rise above the noise. A standalone SaaS from
> the Abetworks suite.

Pricing (from https://connect.abetworks.in/pricing):
- $24 per agent per month
- $240 per agent per year — two months free, one invoice
- 14-day free trial, card up front; cancel anytime from the billing portal

Key pages (base: https://connect.abetworks.in):
- / — product overview
- /pricing — plans and the trial CTA
- /signup — start the free trial
- /login — sign in
- /api/health — service health (JSON)

What it does:
- Scores every incoming message 0–100 by intent and value (verified: a
  40-seat enquiry ranks 100, a marketing blast ranks at the floor)
- Surfaces churn risks before the customer cancels
- One inbox across your channels; priced per agent
- Drafts a reply to the message that scored highest, and the score's reasons
  are readable rather than a number without an explanation
- Outbound webhooks publish each thread's creation, score, hot and at-risk
  events, and every draft and reply, signed (HMAC-SHA256)
- A new workspace can load a sample inbox in one click — six example
  conversations scored by the same engine a real message goes through, so the
  ranking and the reasons are the product's own

Canonical host: https://connect.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
This file is the machine-readable index for AI assistants and crawlers.
